name: Lightish Blue
lede: Lightish Blue is a vivid mid-blue recorded in Wikipedia's color lists, the 2010 xkcd survey and, by Wikipedia's account, Crayola, built from the hedging modifier lightish.

sections.title: A hedged build on blue
sections.body:
Our Color Graph gives Lightish Blue, #3D7AFD, as modifier grammar: lightish plus the base name [[blue]], recorded in Wikipedia's lists, the xkcd survey of 2010, and in a Crayola blue that Wikipedia cites as a near-duplicate [1]. Our data flags the name itself as obscure, qualified or novelty: lightish hedges light the way kind of and sort of hedge other words [1]. The ISCC-NBS system classes the hue as vivid blue, about 9.7 units from that block's center [1]. Its Munsell notation is 6.9PB 5.3/17.5 and its LCH values are lightness 54, chroma 75, hue 290 degrees [1]. The nearest common library name is [[azure]], 3.9 units away [2]. In sRGB its components run 61 red, 122 green and 253 blue, so blue leads by a wide margin while green sits at roughly twice red, the pattern of a strong, cool mid-blue [1].

The one near-duplicate on file is Blue (Crayola), 2.2 units off [2]. See [[blue]] for the primary color this hedged name lightens only slightly.

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: No painting in our 23,781-painting archive has a color within CIEDE2000 4 of Lightish Blue covering even 1% of its canvas, as photographed [3]. That describes this archive, not painting as a whole [3].
